lots.title: Provision of Fire Risk Assessments
lots.description: Lot 1 of the London Borough of Bexley Building Services Framework (Tender 6278), covering the provision of Fire Risk Assessments. This document is the PSQ Reference Appendix scoped to Lot 1; lot identity is asserted on the document and corroborated by the parent notice summary which lists Lot 1 as 'Provision of Fire Risk Assessments'.
requirements: Applicant must supply a previous-engagement reference covering services of the same nature as Lot 1 (Provision of Fire Risk Assessments), including referee contact details, brief description of services provided with dates, and annual contract value.
Reference Part B must be completed by the nominated referee and returned directly to procurement@bexley.gov.uk by 18th May 2026 5pm; references must not be returned via the applicant.

Referee must rate the contractor across six performance dimensions (supply chain resilience, service provision, resource, value for money, contract management, project management) on a five-point scale ranging from 'Failed to meet standard in all areas' to 'Exceeded standard in all areas', and indicate whether they would re-employ the contractor.

warnings.message: Bound document is a PSQ Reference Form (Appendix 1 + Appendix 2 cover letter), not a substantive technical specification. It identifies the lot scope and supplies referee evaluation criteria but contains no technical product specifications, no explicit standards, and no inline CPV codes. Lot description was inferred from the parent notice summary cross-reference.

No explicit technical standards (BS, EN, ISO, RICS, IFE etc.) were referenced in the document body. Per skill contract, no standard refs were emitted; downstream stages must seek standards from a different overlay if Lot 1 standards are needed.

Document does not declare CPV codes. Notice-level CPV codes (50700000-2 / 50750000-7 / 71315000-9) cover the broader 11-lot framework and are not specifically scoped to Fire Risk Assessment services; emitting them at lot scope would be misleading. cpv_codes left empty for Lot 1.

Evaluation criteria captured here are referee-rating dimensions for a prior-experience reference form, not the tender's award criteria. They reflect what the buyer asks the referee to score, which is informative for qualification screening but is not the formal MEAT/award-criteria matrix.

Only one service-shaped product seed was emitted because the document discloses only the lot service title ('Provision of Fire Risk Assessments') without component-level technical attributes, frequency, asset count, or response-time expectations. Downstream matching must treat this as a service-typed seed, not a goods seed.

Appendix 1 PART B states a hard return date of '18th May 2026 by 5pm' for the referee, while Appendix 2 cover letter still contains the unresolved template placeholder '****INSERT DATE & TIME****'. The two appendices disagree on the referee deadline; downstream operators may need to flag this to the buyer.
